  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .86);
  border: 1px solid rgba(17, 24, 39, .20);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(17, 24, 39, .10);
}

.panel-score-legend-median {
  width: 3px;
  background: rgba(71, 85, 105, .72);
}

.panel-score-legend-iqr {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 27px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(37, 99, 235, .15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, .45);
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .panel-score {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: .75rem;
    padding: 1rem;
  }

  .panel-score-number {
    font-size: 2.25rem;
  }
}

.profile-spectrum {
  max-width: 980px;
  margin: 1rem auto 1.45rem auto;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid var(--snpster-border);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem 1rem 1.2rem;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(17, 24, 39, .045);
}

.profile-spectrum-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: .9rem;
}

.profile-spectrum-title {
  color: var(--snpster-text);
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.profile-spectrum-subtitle {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .8rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
  margin-top: .2rem;
  max-width: 700px;
}

.profile-spectrum-counts {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: .35rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.profile-spectrum-count {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .28rem;
  border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: .26rem .48rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .68rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.profile-spectrum-count strong {
  color: var(--snpster-text);
  font-size: .74rem;
}

.profile-spectrum-plot {
  position: relative;
  height: 104px;
  margin: .2rem .35rem 0 .35rem;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    rgba(15, 118, 110, .10) 0%,
    rgba(15, 118, 110, .10) 5%,
    rgba(22, 163, 74, .09) 5%,
    rgba(22, 163, 74, .09) 20%,
    rgba(37, 99, 235, .075) 20%,
    rgba(37, 99, 235, .075) 80%,
    rgba(217, 119, 6, .10) 80%,
    rgba(217, 119, 6, .10) 95%,
    rgba(185, 28, 28, .10) 95%,
    rgba(185, 28, 28, .10) 100%
  );
  border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  overflow: visible;
}

.profile-spectrum-baseline {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: 50%;
  height: 2px;
  background: rgba(100, 116, 139, .28);
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

.profile-spectrum-boundary {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 1px;
  background: rgba(100, 116, 139, .20);
}

.profile-spectrum-point {
  position: absolute;
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(17, 24, 39, .22);
  z-index: 5;
}

.profile-spectrum-point-supported {
  border: 2px solid #ffffff;
}

.profile-spectrum-point-single {
  background: #ffffff !important;
  border-width: 3px;
  border-style: solid;
}

.profile-spectrum-point-low-agreement {
  border-radius: 2px;
  opacity: .52;
  transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);
  border: 2px solid #ffffff;
}

.profile-spectrum-risk-very-low {
  background: var(--risk-very-low);
  border-color: var(--risk-very-low);
}

.profile-spectrum-risk-lowered {
  background: var(--risk-lowered);
  border-color: var(--risk-lowered);
}

.profile-spectrum-risk-normal {
  background: var(--risk-normal);
  border-color: var(--risk-normal);
}

.profile-spectrum-risk-increased {
  background: var(--risk-increased);
  border-color: var(--risk-increased);
}

.profile-spectrum-risk-highly-increased {
  background: var(--risk-highly-increased);
  border-color: var(--risk-highly-increased);
}

.profile-spectrum-point-supported.profile-spectrum-risk-very-low,
.profile-spectrum-point-low-agreement.profile-spectrum-risk-very-low {
  border-color: #ffffff;
}

.profile-spectrum-point-supported.profile-spectrum-risk-lowered,
.profile-spectrum-point-low-agreement.profile-spectrum-risk-lowered {
  border-color: #ffffff;
}

.profile-spectrum-point-supported.profile-spectrum-risk-normal,
.profile-spectrum-point-low-agreement.profile-spectrum-risk-normal {
  border-color: #ffffff;
}

.profile-spectrum-point-supported.profile-spectrum-risk-increased,
.profile-spectrum-point-low-agreement.profile-spectrum-risk-increased {
  border-color: #ffffff;
}

.profile-spectrum-point-supported.profile-spectrum-risk-highly-increased,
.profile-spectrum-point-low-agreement.profile-spectrum-risk-highly-increased {
  border-color: #ffffff;
}

.profile-spectrum-axis {
  position: relative;
  height: 1.05rem;
  margin: .38rem .35rem 0 .35rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .66rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.profile-spectrum-axis-label {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.profile-spectrum-axis-label.edge-left {
  transform: translateX(0);
}

.profile-spectrum-axis-label.edge-right {
  transform: translateX(-100%);
}

.profile-spectrum-bands {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 5fr 15fr 60fr 15fr 5fr;
  margin: .25rem .35rem 0 .35rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .62rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  text-align: center;
}

.profile-spectrum-band {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.profile-spectrum-legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .45rem .9rem;
  margin-top: .8rem;
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .7rem;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.profile-spectrum-legend-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .32rem;
}

.profile-spectrum-legend-dot,
.profile-spectrum-legend-ring,
.profile-spectrum-legend-diamond {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 9px;
  height: 9px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.profile-spectrum-legend-dot {
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #64748b;
  border: 1.5px solid #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(17, 24, 39, .18);
}

.profile-spectrum-legend-ring {
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 2px solid #64748b;
}

.profile-spectrum-legend-diamond {
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: #64748b;
  opacity: .52;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .profile-spectrum {
    padding: .95rem .8rem .9rem .8rem;
  }

  .profile-spectrum-header {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .profile-spectrum-counts {
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }

  .profile-spectrum-bands {
    font-size: .56rem;
  }

  .profile-spectrum-band:nth-child(1),
  .profile-spectrum-band:nth-child(5) {
    display: none;
  }

  .profile-spectrum-bands {
    grid-template-columns: 20fr 60fr 20fr;
  }
}

.reader-guide {
  position: relative;
  margin: 1.15rem auto 2.45rem auto;
  border: 1px solid rgba(203, 213, 225, .82);
  border-radius: 24px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 100% 0%,
      rgba(129, 140, 248, .07),
      transparent 21rem
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, .98),
      rgba(248, 250, 252, .97)
    );
  box-shadow: 0 13px 32px rgba(17, 24, 39, .05);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.reader-guide > summary {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: .9rem;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 1.08rem 1.2rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
  user-select: none;
}

.reader-guide > summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.reader-guide > summary::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 1.2rem;
  right: 1.2rem;
  bottom: 0;
  height: 1px;
  background: rgba(203, 213, 225, .0);
  transition: background .18s ease;
}

.reader-guide[open] > summary::after {
  background: rgba(203, 213, 225, .72);
}

.reader-guide-summary-icon {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #4f5f82;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      rgba(219, 234, 254, .9),
      rgba(237, 233, 254, .76)
    );
  border: 1px solid rgba(129, 140, 248, .18);
  box-shadow:
    0 5px 12px rgba(71, 85, 105, .07),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .72);
}

.reader-guide-summary-icon svg {
  width: 25px;
  height: 25px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.75;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.reader-guide-summary-copy {
  min-width: 0;
}

.reader-guide-summary-kicker {
  color: #6366f1;
  font-size: .66rem;
  line-height: 1;
  font-weight: 860;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .09em;
}

.reader-guide-summary-title {
  margin-top: .24rem;
  color: #172033;
  font-size: 1.06rem;
  line-height: 1.22;
  font-weight: 880;
}

.reader-guide-summary-subtitle {
  margin-top: .22rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .72rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.reader-guide-chevron {
  width: 33px;
  height: 33px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #64748b;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .72);
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, .28);
  transition:
    transform .18s ease,
    background .18s ease;
}

.reader-guide[open] .reader-guide-chevron {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
  background: rgba(238, 242, 255, .9);
}

.reader-guide-chevron svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 2;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.reader-guide-content {
  padding: 1.35rem 1.3rem 1.45rem 1.3rem;
}

.reader-guide-intro {
  max-width: 820px;
  margin-bottom: 1.15rem;
  color: #475569;
  font-size: .86rem;
  line-height: 1.58;
}

.reader-guide-principles {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .72rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.35rem;
}

.reader-guide-principle {
  padding: .78rem .82rem;
  border-radius: 15px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .7);
  border: 1px solid rgba(203, 213, 225, .72);
}

.reader-guide-principle strong {
  display: block;
  color: #334155;
  font-size: .74rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.reader-guide-principle span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: .2rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .67rem;
  line-height: 1.42;
}

.reader-guide-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .9rem;
}

.reader-guide-section {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 1rem 1.05rem;
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .74);
  border: 1px solid rgba(203, 213, 225, .72);
}

.reader-guide-section-wide {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.reader-guide-section h3 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #263449;
  font-size: .94rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  font-weight: 870;
}

.reader-guide-section h4 {
  margin: .85rem 0 .24rem 0;
  color: #334155;
  font-size: .76rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  font-weight: 850;
}

.reader-guide-section p {
  margin: .45rem 0 0 0;
  color: #526174;
  font-size: .75rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.reader-guide-section ul {
  margin: .55rem 0 0 1.05rem;
  padding: 0;
  color: #526174;
  font-size: .73rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.reader-guide-section li + li {
  margin-top: .3rem;
}

.reader-guide-callout {
  margin-top: .72rem;
  padding: .65rem .72rem;
  border-radius: 13px;
  color: #4c5272;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      rgba(238, 242, 255, .8),
      rgba(250, 245, 255, .66)
    );
  border: 1px solid rgba(165, 180, 252, .32);
  font-size: .69rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.guide-figure {
  margin: .8rem 0 0 0;
  padding: .85rem .85rem .75rem .85rem;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border: 1px solid #e6ecf3;
}

.guide-figure figcaption {
  margin-top: .65rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .66rem;
  line-height: 1.42;
}

.guide-figure figcaption strong {
  color: #334155;
}

/* Ten-person percentile example. */
.guide-people-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(10, minmax(23px, 1fr));
  gap: .3rem;
  align-items: end;
  max-width: 520px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.guide-person {
  position: relative;
  height: 44px;
  color: #cbd5e1;
}

.guide-person::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 1px;
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: currentColor;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.guide-person::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 20px;
  height: 27px;
  border-radius: 10px 10px 6px 6px;
  background: currentColor;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.guide-person-highlight {
  color: #818cf8;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 5px rgba(99, 102, 241, .16));
}

/* Mini percentile-bar anatomy. */
.guide-mini-plot {
  position: relative;
  height: 42px;
  margin: .45rem .2rem 0 .2rem;
}

.guide-mini-axis {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: 19px;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #dfe5ec;
}

.guide-mini-range {
  position: absolute;
  left: 14%;
  width: 72%;
  top: 19px;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #d97706;
}

.guide-mini-iqr {
  position: absolute;
  left: 35%;
  width: 31%;
  top: 7px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(37, 99, 235, .20);
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, .48);
}

.guide-mini-dot {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--dot-top);
  left: var(--dot-left);
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(75, 85, 99, .56);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .82);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 5;
}

.guide-mini-median {
  position: absolute;
  left: 51%;
  top: 5px;
  width: 3px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(71, 85, 105, .76);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 7;
}

.guide-mini-legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .42rem .75rem;
  margin-top: .5rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .62rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.guide-mini-legend-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .28rem;
}

.guide-key-dot {
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(75, 85, 99, .58);
}

.guide-key-iqr {
  width: 24px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: rgba(37, 99, 235, .20);
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, .48);
}

.guide-key-range {
  width: 26px;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #d97706;
}

.guide-key-median {
  width: 3px;
  height: 17px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(71, 85, 105, .76);
}

/* Relative-effect bar example. */
.guide-effect-axis-wrap {
  margin-top: .8rem;
}

.guide-effect-axis {
  position: relative;
  height: 42px;
  margin: 0 .2rem;
}

.guide-effect-baseline {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: 19px;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #dfe5ec;
}

.guide-effect-zero {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 7px;
  width: 2px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #94a3b8;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.guide-effect-range {
  position: absolute;
  left: 36%;
  width: 34%;
  top: 19px;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #d97706;
}

.guide-effect-iqr {
  position: absolute;
  left: 47%;
  width: 16%;
  top: 7px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(37, 99, 235, .20);
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, .48);
}

.guide-effect-dot {
  position: absolute;
  left: var(--dot-left);
  top: var(--dot-top);
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(75, 85, 99, .56);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .82);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 5;
}

.guide-effect-median {
  position: absolute;
  left: 56%;
  top: 5px;
  width: 3px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(71, 85, 105, .76);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 7;
}

.guide-effect-weighted {
  position: absolute;
  left: 59%;
  top: 5px;
  width: 4px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .92);
  border: 1px solid rgba(71, 85, 105, .28);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(71, 85, 105, .12);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 6;
}

.guide-effect-labels {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin: .2rem .2rem 0 .2rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .61rem;
  font-weight: 720;
}

.guide-ratio-examples {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .55rem;
  margin-top: .75rem;
}

.guide-ratio-example {
  padding: .68rem .72rem;
  border-radius: 13px;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border: 1px solid #e6ecf3;
}

.guide-ratio-example-value {
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.guide-ratio-example-label {
  margin-top: .24rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .64rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.reader-guide-evidence-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .52rem;
  margin-top: .72rem;
}

.reader-guide-evidence-item {
  padding: .62rem .68rem;
  border-radius: 13px;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border: 1px solid #e6ecf3;
}

.reader-guide-evidence-item strong {
  display: block;
  color: #334155;
  font-size: .69rem;
}

.reader-guide-evidence-item span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: .18rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .63rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.reader-guide-footer {
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding: .78rem .85rem;
  border-radius: 15px;
  color: #5b6474;
  background: rgba(248, 250, 252, .9);
  border: 1px dashed rgba(148, 163, 184, .48);
  font-size: .69rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .reader-guide > summary {
    grid-template-columns: 42px minmax(0, 1fr) 30px;
    gap: .72rem;
    padding: .95rem .9rem;
  }

  .reader-guide-summary-icon {
    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }

  .reader-guide-summary-subtitle {
    display: none;
  }

  .reader-guide-content {
    padding: 1.05rem .9rem 1.2rem .9rem;
  }

  .reader-guide-principles,
  .reader-guide-grid,
  .guide-ratio-examples,
  .reader-guide-evidence-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .reader-guide-section-wide {
    grid-column: auto;
  }

  .guide-people-row {
    gap: .18rem;
  }

  .guide-person {
    height: 37px;
  }

  .guide-person::before {
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
  }

  .guide-person::after {
    width: 17px;
    height: 23px;
  }
}

.story-section {
  margin: 3rem auto 3.5rem auto;
  --section-divider-accent: rgba(100, 116, 139, .24);
}

.story-section-header {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 1.2rem;
  align-items: center;
  margin: 0 0 1.15rem 0;
  padding: 1.2rem 1.3rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--snpster-border);
  border-radius: 22px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(17, 24, 39, .04);
}

.story-section-header::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0 auto 0 0;
  width: 5px;
  border-radius: 22px 0 0 22px;
}

.story-section-header::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  width: 190px;
  height: 190px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  right: -88px;
  top: -118px;
  opacity: .45;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.story-section-header-main {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: .95rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.story-section-emblem {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 50px;
  height: 50px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .76);
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, .25);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .7),
    0 5px 13px rgba(17, 24, 39, .045);
}

.story-section-emblem svg {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.8;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.story-section-copy {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.story-section-kicker {
  font-size: .7rem;
  line-height: 1;
  font-weight: 850;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .09em;
  margin-bottom: .38rem;
}

.story-section-title {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--snpster-text);
  font-size: 1.52rem;
  line-height: 1.18;
  font-weight: 880;
  letter-spacing: -.015em;
}

.story-section-subtitle {
  margin-top: .38rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .88rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  max-width: 740px;
}

.story-section-count {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 84px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: .4rem .7rem;
  font-size: .73rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .8);
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, .27);
  color: #475569;
}

.story-section-flow-divider {
  position: relative;
  height: 36px;
  margin: -.15rem auto .25rem auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.story-section-flow-divider::before {
  content: "";
  width: min(100%, 300px);
  height: 1px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent 0%,
      var(--section-divider-accent) 16%,
      var(--section-divider-accent) 84%,
      transparent 100%
    );
}

.story-section-flow-divider::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  width: 15px;
  height: 15px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .95);
  border: 1px solid var(--section-divider-accent);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 11px rgba(17, 24, 39, .06);
}

.story-section-standout {
  --section-divider-accent: rgba(217, 119, 6, .31);
}

.story-section-standout .story-section-header {
  background: linear-gradient(
    120deg,
    rgba(255, 251, 235, .96) 0%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, .98) 72%
  );
}

.story-section-standout .story-section-header::before {
  background: #d97706;
}

.story-section-standout .story-section-header::after {
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, .12);
}

.story-section-standout .story-section-kicker,
.story-section-standout .story-section-emblem {
  color: #b45309;
}

.story-section-caution {
  --section-divider-accent: rgba(124, 58, 237, .30);
}

.story-section-caution .story-section-header {
  background: linear-gradient(
    120deg,
    rgba(250, 245, 255, .96) 0%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, .98) 72%
  );
}

.story-section-caution .story-section-header::before {
  background: #7c3aed;
}

.story-section-caution .story-section-header::after {
  background: rgba(124, 58, 237, .10);
}

.story-section-caution .story-section-kicker,
.story-section-caution .story-section-emblem {
  color: #6d28d9;
}

.story-section-other {
  --section-divider-accent: rgba(71, 85, 105, .25);
}

.story-section-other .story-section-header {
  background: linear-gradient(
    120deg,
    rgba(248, 250, 252, .98) 0%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, .98) 72%
  );
}

.story-section-other .story-section-header::before {
  background: #64748b;
}

.story-section-other .story-section-header::after {
  background: rgba(100, 116, 139, .08);
}

.story-section-other .story-section-kicker,
.story-section-other .story-section-emblem {
  color: #475569;
}

/* Keep cards full-width while creating a deliberate pause between them. */
.card-stack-item {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}

.card-stack-item + .card-stack-item {
  margin-top: 1.15rem;
}

.card-stack-item + .card-stack-item::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: -1.82rem;
  width: min(210px, 36vw);
  height: 1px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent 0%,
      var(--section-divider-accent) 14%,
      var(--section-divider-accent) 86%,
      transparent 100%
    );
  opacity: .95;
}

.card-stack-item + .card-stack-item::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: -2.4rem;
  width: 21px;
  height: 21px;
  transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .96);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--section-divider-accent);
  box-shadow:
    0 5px 13px rgba(17, 24, 39, .07),
    inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(248, 250, 252, .76);
}

.pgs-context-box {
  max-width: 860px;
  margin: -.05rem 0 1.15rem 0;
  padding: .82rem .92rem .86rem .92rem;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .62);
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, .30);
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(17, 24, 39, .035);
}

@supports (border-color: color-mix(in srgb, red 50%, transparent)) {
  .pgs-context-box {
    border-color:
      color-mix(
        in srgb,
        var(--card-accent) 19%,
        rgba(148, 163, 184, .30) 81%
      );
  }
}

.pgs-context-heading {
  color: #334155;
  font-size: .72rem;
  font-weight: 860;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .065em;
  margin-bottom: .34rem;
}

.pgs-context-result {
  color: #273449;
  font-size: .9rem;
  font-weight: 720;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.pgs-context-description {
  color: #526174;
  font-size: .8rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-top: .42rem;
}

.pgs-summary-transition {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 72px;
  margin: -.1rem 0 -.25rem 0;
  color: #64748b;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.pgs-summary-transition::before,
.pgs-summary-transition::after {
  content: "";
  width: 1px;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 13px;
  background: rgba(100, 116, 139, .30);
}

.pgs-summary-transition-node {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .82);
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, .38);
  box-shadow:
    0 3px 9px rgba(17, 24, 39, .07),
    inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, .52);
}

@supports (border-color: color-mix(in srgb, red 50%, transparent)) {
  .pgs-summary-transition::before,
  .pgs-summary-transition::after {
    background:
      color-mix(
        in srgb,
        var(--card-accent) 28%,
        rgba(100, 116, 139, .30) 72%
      );
  }

  .pgs-summary-transition-node {
    border-color:
      color-mix(
        in srgb,
        var(--card-accent) 38%,
        rgba(148, 163, 184, .38) 62%
      );
    background:
      color-mix(
        in srgb,
        var(--card-accent) 7%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, .88) 93%
      );
  }
}

.pgs-summary-transition-node svg {
  display: block;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.9;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.agreement-callout {
  border-left: 3px solid #7c3aed;
  background: #faf5ff;
  color: #5b21b6;
  border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0;
  padding: .55rem .7rem;
  margin: -.2rem 0 1rem 0;
  font-size: .78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.4;
}


.method-details summary {
  cursor: pointer;
  color: #374151;
  font-weight: 850;
  font-size: .92rem;
}

.method-details-content {
  margin-top: .85rem;
}

.method-details-content p {
  margin: .55rem 0;
}

.pgs-card-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 2.55rem;
  align-items: start;
  margin: 1.15rem auto 0 auto;
}

.pgs-card {
  --card-accent: #64748b;
  --card-detail-accent: #475569;
  position: relative;
  background: var(--snpster-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--snpster-border);
  border-radius: 22px;
  padding: 1.35rem 1.45rem;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(17, 24, 39, .06);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
  height: auto;
  min-width: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pgs-card::before,
.pgs-card::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/*
  Broad concentric arcs. The motif spans much of the card but is intentionally
  very low contrast so the card content remains visually dominant.
*/
.pgs-card::before {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 96% 4%,
      transparent 0 82px,
      rgba(100, 116, 139, .055) 83px 84px,
      transparent 85px 126px,
      rgba(100, 116, 139, .045) 127px 128px,
      transparent 129px 172px,
      rgba(100, 116, 139, .035) 173px 174px,
      transparent 175px
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 4% 98%,
      transparent 0 108px,
      rgba(100, 116, 139, .032) 109px 110px,
      transparent 111px 158px,
      rgba(100, 116, 139, .026) 159px 160px,
      transparent 161px
    );
}

/* Faint dot field and diagonal sweep across the right half of the card. */
.pgs-card::after {
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(
      circle,
      rgba(100, 116, 139, .06) 0 1px,
      transparent 1.2px
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      132deg,
      transparent 0 68%,
      rgba(100, 116, 139, .022) 68.2% 68.45%,
      transparent 68.65% 74%,
      rgba(100, 116, 139, .018) 74.2% 74.45%,
      transparent 74.65%
    );
  background-size: 16px 16px, 100% 100%;
  background-position: right top, center;
  -webkit-mask-image:
    linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, transparent 42%, #000 79%);
  mask-image:
    linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, transparent 42%, #000 79%);
  opacity: .72;
}

.pgs-card > * {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

@supports (background: color-mix(in srgb, red 50%, transparent)) {
  .pgs-card::before {
    background:
      radial-gradient(
        circle at 96% 4%,
        transparent 0 82px,
        color-mix(
          in srgb,
          var(--card-accent) 10%,
          transparent 90%
        ) 83px 84px,
        transparent 85px 126px,
        color-mix(
          in srgb,
          var(--card-accent) 7.5%,
          transparent 92.5%
        ) 127px 128px,
        transparent 129px 172px,
        color-mix(
          in srgb,
          var(--card-accent) 5.5%,
          transparent 94.5%
        ) 173px 174px,
        transparent 175px
      ),
      radial-gradient(
        circle at 4% 98%,
        transparent 0 108px,
        color-mix(
          in srgb,
          var(--card-accent) 5%,
          transparent 95%
        ) 109px 110px,
        transparent 111px 158px,
        color-mix(
          in srgb,
          var(--card-accent) 3.8%,
          transparent 96.2%
        ) 159px 160px,
        transparent 161px
      );
  }

  .pgs-card::after {
    background-image:
      radial-gradient(
        circle,
        color-mix(
          in srgb,
          var(--card-accent) 8.5%,
          transparent 91.5%
        ) 0 1px,
        transparent 1.2px
      ),
      linear-gradient(
        132deg,
        transparent 0 68%,
        color-mix(
          in srgb,
          var(--card-accent) 4.6%,
          transparent 95.4%
        ) 68.2% 68.45%,
        transparent 68.65% 74%,
        color-mix(
          in srgb,
          var(--card-accent) 3.8%,
          transparent 96.2%
        ) 74.2% 74.45%,
        transparent 74.65%
      );
  }
}

.pgs-card.card-risk-very-low {
  --card-accent: var(--risk-very-low);
  --card-detail-accent: #0f5f59;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      rgba(15, 118, 110, .11) 0%,
      rgba(15, 118, 110, .055) 38%,
      rgba(15, 118, 110, .024) 72%,
      rgba(15, 118, 110, .008) 100%
    );
}

.pgs-card.card-risk-lowered {
  --card-accent: var(--risk-lowered);
  --card-detail-accent: #137a38;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      rgba(22, 163, 74, .105) 0%,
      rgba(22, 163, 74, .052) 38%,
      rgba(22, 163, 74, .022) 72%,
      rgba(22, 163, 74, .008) 100%
    );
}

.pgs-card.card-risk-normal {
  --card-accent: var(--risk-normal);
  --card-detail-accent: #1d4ed8;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, .105) 0%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, .052) 38%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, .022) 72%,
      rgba(37, 99, 235, .008) 100%
    );
}

.pgs-card.card-risk-increased {
  --card-accent: var(--risk-increased);
  --card-detail-accent: #a85605;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      rgba(217, 119, 6, .12) 0%,
      rgba(217, 119, 6, .058) 38%,
      rgba(217, 119, 6, .025) 72%,
      rgba(217, 119, 6, .009) 100%
    );
}

.pgs-card.card-risk-highly-increased {
  --card-accent: var(--risk-highly-increased);
  --card-detail-accent: #8f1717;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      rgba(185, 28, 28, .115) 0%,
      rgba(185, 28, 28, .055) 38%,
      rgba(185, 28, 28, .024) 72%,
      rgba(185, 28, 28, .008) 100%
    );
}



@supports (border-color: color-mix(in srgb, red 50%, transparent)) {
  .pgs-card {
    border-color:
      color-mix(
        in srgb,
        var(--card-accent) 18%,
        var(--snpster-border) 82%
      );
  }
}

.pgs-card-header {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  column-gap: 1.15rem;
  row-gap: .65rem;
  align-items: start;
  margin-bottom: .8rem;
}

.pgs-header-left {
  min-width: 0;
}

.pgs-title-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .55rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.pgs-percentile-hero {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  justify-self: center;
  min-width: 190px;
  padding: .9rem 1rem .45rem 1rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.pgs-percentile-hero-label {
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .67rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .085em;
}

.pgs-percentile-hero-value {
  color: var(--snpster-text);
  font-size: 2.35rem;
  line-height: .98;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: -.045em;
  margin-top: .22rem;
}

.pgs-percentile-hero-badge {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-top: .55rem;
}

.pgs-percentile-hero-badge .risk-badge {
  margin: 0;
  padding: .28rem .72rem;
  font-size: .73rem;
  line-height: 1.15;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 7px rgba(17, 24, 39, .055);
}

.pgs-percentile-hero-caption {
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: .64rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  margin-top: .45rem;
}

.pgs-percentile-hero-rule {
  width: 62px;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--card-accent);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-accent) 38%, transparent),
      var(--card-accent) 34%,
      var(--card-detail-accent) 66%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-accent) 38%, transparent)
    );
  box-shadow:
    0 3px 9px
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-accent) 20%, transparent);
  margin: .5rem auto 0 auto;
}

.pgs-header-right {
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.header-evidence-orbs {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: .32rem;
}

.header-evidence-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .12rem;
}

.header-evidence-orb {
  width: 45px;
  height: 45px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 30% 24%,
      rgba(255,255,255,.99),
      rgba(255,255,255,.83) 38%,
      rgba(247,249,252,.96) 100%
    );
  border: 1px solid #dbe3ee;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 12px rgba(17, 24, 39, .055);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.header-evidence-icon {
  width: 15px;
  height: 15px;
  color: #64748b;
  line-height: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.header-evidence-icon svg {
  display: block;
  width: 15px;
  height: 15px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.75;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.header-evidence-value {
  color: var(--snpster-text);
  font-size: .82rem;
  line-height: 1;
  font-weight: 860;
  margin-top: .08rem;
}

.header-evidence-label {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  max-width: 62px;
  font-size: .5rem;
  font-weight: 760;
  line-height: 1.1;
  text-align: center;
  white-space: normal;
}

.pgs-title {
  font-size: 1.16rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--snpster-text);
  line-height: 1.25;
  margin: 0;
}

.pgs-subtitle {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .84rem;
  margin-top: .25rem;
}

.pgs-id-badge {
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: var(--snpster-soft);
  color: #374151;
  border: 1px solid var(--snpster-border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: .25rem .55rem;
  font-size: .76rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.risk-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: .3rem .65rem;
  font-size: .78rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin-bottom: .9rem;
  width: fit-content;
}

.risk-very-low {
  color: #064e3b;
  background: #ccfbf1;
}

.risk-lowered {
  color: #14532d;
  background: #dcfce7;
}

.risk-normal {
  color: #1e3a8a;
  background: #dbeafe;
}

.risk-increased {
  color: #92400e;
  background: #fef3c7;
}

.risk-highly-increased {
  color: #7f1d1d;
  background: #fee2e2;
}


.model-agreement {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .38rem .55rem;
  margin: -.25rem 0 .95rem 0;
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .78rem;
}

.model-agreement-label {
  color: #4b5563;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.model-agreement-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: .2rem .5rem;
  font-size: .7rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.model-agreement-phenomenal {
  color: #312e81;
  background: #eef2ff;
  border-color: #c7d2fe;
}

.model-agreement-very-good {
  color: #1d4ed8;
  background: #eff6ff;
  border-color: #bfdbfe;
}

.model-agreement-good {
  color: #475569;
  background: #f1f5f9;
  border-color: #cbd5e1;
}


.model-agreement-moderate {
  color: #6d28d9;
  background: #f5f3ff;
  border-color: #ddd6fe;
}

.model-agreement-bad {
  color: #6b21a8;
  background: #faf5ff;
  border-color: #e9d5ff;
}

.model-agreement-not-assessable {
  color: #4b5563;
  background: #f3f4f6;
  border-color: #e5e7eb;
}

.model-agreement-caption {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-weight: 650;
}


.model-agreement-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.model-agreement-header .model-agreement-badge {
  font-size: .72rem;
  padding: .28rem .58rem;
}

.percentile-block {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 0 1.55rem 0;
}

.percentile-topline {
  display: flex;
  align-items: end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: .4rem;
}

.percentile-label {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .92rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.percentile-value {
  color: var(--snpster-text);
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  line-height: 1;
}

.percentile-track {
  position: relative;
  height: 13px;
  background: #e5e7eb;
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: visible;
}

.percentile-track.has-jitter {
  margin-top: .65rem;
  margin-bottom: .75rem;
}

.percentile-model-point {
  position: absolute;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(75, 85, 99, .58);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .82);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(17, 24, 39, .12);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 6;
}

.legend-model-point-key {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(75, 85, 99, .68);
}

.percentile-fill,
.percentile-solid,
.percentile-uncertainty {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.percentile-solid {
  left: 0;
}

.percentile-uncertainty {
  opacity: 0.32;
}

/* IQR overlay for multi-PGS cards: sits on top of the skinny percentile baseline. */
.percentile-iqr-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  top: -6px;
  height: 25px;
  background: rgba(37, 99, 235, .25);
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, .66);
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow:
    0 2px 8px rgba(17, 24, 39, .10),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .20);
  z-index: 4;
}

.percentile-iqr-overlay + .percentile-marker,
.percentile-track .percentile-marker {
  z-index: 12;
}

.percentile-marker {
  position: absolute;
  top: -6px;
  width: 3px;
  height: 25px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(71, 85, 105, .72);
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(71, 85, 105, .14);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 12;
  pointer-events: none;
}


.scale-axis-labels {
  position: relative;
  height: 1.15rem;
  margin-top: .42rem;
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .68rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1;
}

.scale-axis-label {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.scale-axis-label.edge-left {
  transform: translateX(0);
}

.scale-axis-label.edge-right {
  transform: translateX(-100%);
}

.percentile-legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .55rem .9rem;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: .55rem;
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .76rem;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.legend-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .32rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.legend-swatch {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 26px;
  height: 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.legend-swatch.translucent {
  opacity: .32;
}

.legend-marker-key {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 5px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #111827;
  border: 2px solid #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(17, 24, 39, .30);
}

.consensus-box {
  background: #f9fafb;
  border: 1px solid var(--snpster-border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: .65rem .75rem;
  margin-top: .65rem;
}

.consensus-value {
  color: var(--snpster-text);
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  margin-top: .15rem;
}

.percentile-boxplot {
  position: relative;
  height: 24px;
  margin-top: .45rem;
}

.percentile-boxplot-track {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: 10px;
  height: 4px;
  background: #e5e7eb;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.percentile-boxplot-whisker {
  position: absolute;
  top: 10px;
  height: 4px;
  background: #9ca3af;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.percentile-boxplot-iqr {
  position: absolute;
  top: 5px;
  height: 14px;
  background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.16);
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.45);
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.percentile-boxplot-median,
.percentile-boxplot-primary {
  position: absolute;
  top: 2px;
  width: 4px;
  height: 20px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.percentile-boxplot-median {
  background: #2563eb;
}

.percentile-boxplot-primary {
  background: #111827;
  border: 2px solid #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(17, 24, 39, .30);
}

.percentile-boxplot-caption {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .74rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  margin-top: .25rem;
}

.percentile-distribution {
  margin-top: .55rem;
}

.percentile-distribution-track {
  position: relative;
  height: 34px;
  margin-top: .35rem;
}

.percentile-distribution-axis {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: 15px;
  height: 4px;
  background: #e5e7eb;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.percentile-distribution-whisker {
  position: absolute;
  top: 15px;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.percentile-distribution-iqr {
  position: absolute;
  top: 3px;
  height: 28px;
  background: rgba(37, 99, 235, .25);
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, .66);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .18),
    0 2px 7px rgba(17, 24, 39, .08);
}

.percentile-distribution-mean {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1px;
  width: 3px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(71, 85, 105, .72);
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(71, 85, 105, .13);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 12;
  pointer-events: none;
}





.percentile-distribution-point {
  position: absolute;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(75, 85, 99, .54);
  border: 1.25px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .78);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(17, 24, 39, .10);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 6;
}

.percentile-distribution-iqr-marker {
  position: absolute;
  top: 10px;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
  border-top: 6px solid transparent;
  border-bottom: 6px solid transparent;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.percentile-distribution-iqr-marker.left {
  border-right: 8px solid #374151;
}

.percentile-distribution-iqr-marker.right {
  border-left: 8px solid #374151;
}

.percentile-distribution-caption {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .76rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  margin-top: .32rem;
}

.percentile-distribution-legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .55rem .9rem;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: .55rem;
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .76rem;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.legend-mean-key {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 3px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(71, 85, 105, .72);
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(71, 85, 105, .12);
}

.legend-iqr-key {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 28px;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.16);
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.50);
}

.fill-very-low {
  background: var(--risk-very-low);
}

.fill-lowered {
  background: var(--risk-lowered);
}

.fill-normal {
  background: var(--risk-normal);
}

.fill-increased {
  background: var(--risk-increased);
}

.fill-highly-increased {
  background: var(--risk-highly-increased);
}

.metric-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .65rem;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 1.45rem 0 1.35rem 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #dce3eb;
}

.metric-box {
  background: #fbfcfe;
  border: 1px solid var(--snpster-border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: .75rem .8rem;
}

.metric-label {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .75rem;
  font-weight: 750;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .035em;
}

.metric-value {
  color: var(--snpster-text);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin-top: .2rem;
}

.metric-caption {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .76rem;
  margin-top: .14rem;
}


.metric-value-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .65rem;
  margin-top: .2rem;
}

.metric-value-row .metric-value {
  margin-top: 0;
}

.metric-status-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: .2rem .5rem;
  font-size: .68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}

.metric-status-bad {
  color: #7f1d1d;
  background: #fee2e2;
  border-color: #fecaca;
}

.metric-status-acceptable {
  color: #92400e;
  background: #fef3c7;
  border-color: #fde68a;
}

.metric-status-good {
  color: #1e3a8a;
  background: #dbeafe;
  border-color: #bfdbfe;
}

.metric-status-phenomenal {
  color: #14532d;
  background: #dcfce7;
  border-color: #bbf7d0;
}


.pgs-detailed-section {
  position: relative;
  margin: 1.35rem -1.45rem -1.35rem -1.45rem;
  padding: 0 1.45rem 1.35rem 1.45rem;
  background: transparent;
}

.card-details-divider {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .85rem;
  margin: 0 0 1.65rem 0;
  padding: .95rem 0 1.05rem 0;
  background: transparent;
}

.card-details-divider::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: -1.45rem;
  right: -1.45rem;
  bottom: 0;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-accent) 38%, transparent) 0%,
      var(--card-accent) 16%,
      var(--card-detail-accent) 50%,
      var(--card-accent) 84%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-accent) 38%, transparent) 100%
    );
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .82),
    0 3px 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-accent) 18%, transparent);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.card-details-divider::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: -1.45rem;
  right: -1.45rem;
  bottom: 0;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--card-accent);
  opacity: .72;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@supports (background: color-mix(in srgb, red 50%, transparent)) {
  .card-details-divider::before {
    display: none;
  }
}

.card-details-divider-title {
  color: #334155;
  font-size: .78rem;
  font-weight: 880;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .075em;
}

.card-details-divider .model-agreement-header {
  margin: 0;
  align-items: center;
}

.card-details-divider .model-agreement-badge {
  font-size: .7rem;
  padding: .25rem .52rem;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .pgs-detailed-section {
    margin-left: -1rem;
    margin-right: -1rem;
    margin-bottom: -1rem;
    padding-left: 1rem;
    padding-right: 1rem;
    padding-bottom: 1rem;
  }

  .card-details-divider::before,
  .card-details-divider::after {
    left: -1rem;
    right: -1rem;
  }
}


.effect-bar-stack {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 1.45rem 0 1.55rem 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #dce3eb;
}

.effect-bar-panel {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.effect-bar-panel + .effect-bar-panel {
  margin-top: 1.55rem;
  padding-top: 1.55rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #dce3eb;
}

.effect-bar-panel.unavailable {
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.effect-bar-topline {
  display: flex;
  align-items: end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: .4rem;
}

.effect-bar-label {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .92rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-transform: none;
  letter-spacing: normal;
}

.effect-bar-value {
  color: var(--snpster-text);
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: right;
}

.effect-bar-caption {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .76rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  margin-top: .32rem;
}

.effect-distribution {
  margin: 0;
}

.effect-distribution-track {
  position: relative;
  height: 13px;
  background: #e5e7eb;
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: visible;
  margin-top: .65rem;
  margin-bottom: .75rem;
}

.effect-distribution-axis {
  display: none;
}

.effect-distribution-centerfill {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  z-index: 1;
}

.effect-distribution-zero {
  position: absolute;
  top: -5px;
  width: 2px;
  height: 23px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #6b7280;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 4;
}

.effect-distribution-range {
  position: absolute;
  top: 4px;
  height: 5px;
  background: #6b7280;
  border-radius: 999px;
  z-index: 3;
}


.effect-distribution-range.fill-increased {
  background: var(--risk-increased);
}

.effect-distribution-range.fill-lowered {
  background: var(--risk-lowered);
}

.effect-distribution-iqr {
  position: absolute;
  top: -4px;
  height: 21px;
  background: rgba(37, 99, 235, .25);
  border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, .66);
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow:
    0 2px 8px rgba(17, 24, 39, .10),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .20);
  z-index: 2;
}

/* 3+ effect models: use the colored observed-range line as the skinny baseline and place the thicker IQR band over it. */
.effect-distribution-track.multi-model {
  height: 34px;
  background: transparent;
  margin-top: .35rem;
  margin-bottom: .15rem;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-axis {
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: 15px;
  height: 4px;
  background: #e5e7eb;
  border-radius: 999px;
  z-index: 0;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-centerfill {
  top: 15px;
  height: 4px;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-range {
  top: 15px;
  height: 4px;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-iqr {
  top: 3px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-zero {
  top: 6px;
  height: 22px;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .legend-snpster-diamond-key {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 4px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .86);
  border: 1px solid rgba(17, 24, 39, .20);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(17, 24, 39, .10);
  margin: 0 .15rem;
}


.effect-distribution-point {
  position: absolute;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(75, 85, 99, .52);
  border: 1.25px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .76);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(17, 24, 39, .10);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 6;
}


.effect-distribution-snpster-mean {
  position: absolute;
  top: -7px;
  width: 4px;
  height: 27px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .86);
  border: 1px solid rgba(17, 24, 39, .22);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(17, 24, 39, .11);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 11;
  pointer-events: none;
}


.effect-distribution-median {
  position: absolute;
  top: -7px;
  width: 3px;
  height: 27px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(71, 85, 105, .72);
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(71, 85, 105, .13);
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 12;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-snpster-mean {
  top: 1px;
  width: 4px;
  height: 32px;
}

.effect-distribution-track.multi-model .effect-distribution-median {
  top: 1px;
  width: 3px;
  height: 32px;
}







.metadata-panel {
  margin-top: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #dce3eb;
  padding-top: 1.15rem;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
}

.metadata-panel details {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: .3rem 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.metadata-panel summary {
  cursor: pointer;
  color: #374151;
  font-size: .85rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.meta-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: .45rem;
  margin-top: .7rem;
}

.meta-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 190px 1fr;
  gap: .6rem;
  font-size: .82rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.meta-key {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.meta-value {
  color: #1f2937;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.model-table-wrap {
  display: block;
  inline-size: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  overflow-y: hidden;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
  contain: inline-size;
  margin-top: .75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--snpster-border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  background: #ffffff;
}

.model-table-scroll-hint {
  color: var(--snpster-muted);
  font-size: .74rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  margin-top: .45rem;
}

.model-table {
  width: 1420px;
  min-width: 1420px;
  max-width: none;
  table-layout: fixed;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: .70rem;
}

.model-table th,
.model-table td {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--snpster-border);
  padding: .32rem .36rem;
  text-align: left;
  vertical-align: top;
  white-space: normal;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  word-break: break-word;
}

.model-table th {
  color: #374151;
  background: #f9fafb;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.model-table td {
  color: #1f2937;
}

.model-table th:nth-child(1),
.model-table td:nth-child(1) {
  width: 82px;
}

.model-table th:nth-child(2),
.model-table td:nth-child(2),
.model-table th:nth-child(3),
.model-table td:nth-child(3),
.model-table th:nth-child(6),
.model-table td:nth-child(6),
.model-table th:nth-child(8),
.model-table td:nth-child(8) {
  width: 82px;
}

.model-table th:nth-child(4),
.model-table td:nth-child(4),
.model-table th:nth-child(5),
.model-table td:nth-child(5) {
  width: 98px;
}

.model-table th:nth-child(7),
.model-table td:nth-child(7),
.model-table th:nth-child(9),
.model-table td:nth-child(9) {
  width: 78px;
}

.model-table th:nth-child(10),
.model-table td:nth-child(10) {
  width: 130px;
}


.model-table th:nth-child(11),
.model-table td:nth-child(11) {
  width: 175px;
}

.model-table th:nth-child(12),
.model-table td:nth-child(12) {
  width: 82px;
}

.model-table th:nth-child(13),

#| include: false
from IPython.display import HTML, display
import html
import math
import hashlib
import re
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd().parent / "database_module"))

from db_handler import DbHandler, DbUtils
from db_config import USERNAME, PASSWORD, DATABASE_NAME, HOST, PORT, PGS_EXCEL_FILEPATH

db_handler = DbHandler(
    port=PORT,
    db_url=None,
    user=USERNAME,
    password=PASSWORD,
    host=HOST,
)
db_handler.connect()
db_utils = DbUtils(db_handler)

prsc_id = 3102  # placeholder for testing jobs


# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Resolve the user's primary ancestry.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
ethnicity_query = f"""
SELECT * 
FROM snpster_users.user_ancestry
WHERE user_id = (
    SELECT user_id
    FROM snpster_users.imputation_jobs
    WHERE imputation_id IN (
        SELECT imputation_id
        FROM snpster_users.prsc_jobs
        WHERE prsc_id = {prsc_id}
        LIMIT 1
    )
)
"""

ancestry_df = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(ethnicity_query)

if ancestry_df.empty:
    raise ValueError(f"No ancestry record found for prsc_id={prsc_id}.")

primary_ancestry_code = ancestry_df["primary_ancestry"].iloc[0]

if pd.isna(primary_ancestry_code):
    raise ValueError(
        f"Primary ancestry has not been assigned for prsc_id={prsc_id}."
    )

primary_ancestry_code = str(primary_ancestry_code).strip().upper()

# Map SNPster's five ancestry codes onto the broad-ancestry labels that
# actually occur in evaluation_sample_sets.broad_ancestry_category.
#
# The ESS field can contain several comma-separated ancestry labels in one
# value (for example "European, African unspecified, East Asian").  Therefore
# the SQL below matches individual recognized tokens instead of requiring the
# entire field to equal one string.
#
# Ambiguous categories such as "Asian unspecified", "Other admixed ancestry",
# "Greater Middle Eastern ...", "Oceanian", "Other", and NR/Not reported are
# deliberately NOT forced into one of the five SNPster superpopulations.
ancestry_display_map = {
    "EUR": "European",
    "AFR": "African",
    "EAS": "East Asian",
    "SAS": "South Asian",
    "AMR": "Admixed American",
}

ancestry_token_map = {
    "EUR": [
        "European",
    ],
    "AFR": [
        "African unspecified",
        "African American or Afro-Caribbean",
        "Sub-Saharan African",
    ],
    "EAS": [
        "East Asian",
        "South East Asian",
    ],
    "SAS": [
        "South Asian",
    ],
    "AMR": [
        "Hispanic or Latin American",
        "Native American",
    ],
}

if primary_ancestry_code not in ancestry_token_map:
    raise ValueError(
        f"Unsupported primary ancestry code: {primary_ancestry_code}"
    )

ethnicity = ancestry_display_map[primary_ancestry_code]
ancestry_tokens = ancestry_token_map[primary_ancestry_code]

# These labels are fixed application constants, but quote them defensively
# before embedding them into the SQL ARRAY literal.
ethnicity_sql = ethnicity.replace("'", "''")
ancestry_tokens_sql = ", ".join(
    "'" + token.replace("'", "''").lower() + "'"
    for token in ancestry_tokens
)


# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1b. Resolve report identity and generation metadata.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
report_job_query = f"""
SELECT ij.*
FROM snpster_users.prsc_jobs AS pj
JOIN snpster_users.imputation_jobs AS ij
    ON ij.imputation_id = pj.imputation_id
WHERE pj.prsc_id = {prsc_id}
LIMIT 1
"""

report_job_df = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(report_job_query)

if report_job_df.empty:
    raise ValueError(
        f"No imputation-job context found for prsc_id={prsc_id}."
    )

report_job_row = report_job_df.iloc[0]
report_user_id = str(report_job_row.get("user_id", "Unknown profile")).strip()
report_user_id_sql = report_user_id.replace("'", "''")


def first_nonempty_value(row, candidates):
    """Return the first non-empty value from candidate columns."""
    if row is None:
        return None

    for column in candidates:
        if column not in row.index:
            continue

        value = row[column]

        if pd.isna(value):
            continue

        value = str(value).strip()

        if value:
            return value

    return None


try:
    report_profile_query = f"""
    SELECT *
    FROM snpster_users.user_information
    WHERE user_id = '{report_user_id_sql}'
    LIMIT 1
    """
    report_profile_df = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(
        report_profile_query
    )
except Exception:
    report_profile_df = pd.DataFrame()

report_profile_row = (
    report_profile_df.iloc[0]
    if not report_profile_df.empty
    else None
)

report_full_name = first_nonempty_value(
    report_profile_row,
    [
        "full_name",
        "display_name",
        "name",
        "user_name",
        "username",
    ],
)

if report_full_name is None:
    report_first_name = first_nonempty_value(
        report_profile_row,
        ["first_name", "firstname", "given_name"],
    )
    report_last_name = first_nonempty_value(
        report_profile_row,
        ["last_name", "lastname", "family_name", "surname"],
    )
    report_full_name = " ".join(
        value
        for value in [report_first_name, report_last_name]
        if value
    ).strip()

if not report_full_name:
    report_full_name = report_user_id

report_data_source = first_nonempty_value(
    report_job_row,
    [
        "data_source",
        "genotyping_vendor",
        "vendor",
        "source_vendor",
        "file_provider",
        "input_vendor",
        "provider",
    ],
)

if report_data_source is None:
    report_data_source = "Uploaded genotype data"

report_now = datetime.now()
report_date = (
    f"{report_now.strftime('%B')} {report_now.day}, {report_now.year}"
)
report_identifier = f"SNPSTER-{prsc_id}"
report_version = "1.0"


# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Find PSS IDs relevant to that ancestry, then use those PSS IDs
#    to retrieve their PPM performance rows.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
query = f"""
WITH ancestry_matched_ess AS (
    SELECT ess.*
    FROM data_libraries.evaluation_sample_sets AS ess
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM unnest(
            string_to_array(
                COALESCE(ess.broad_ancestry_category, ''),
                ','
            )
        ) AS ancestry_token(value)
        WHERE lower(btrim(ancestry_token.value)) = ANY (
            ARRAY[{ancestry_tokens_sql}]::text[]
        )
    )
),

ancestry_matched_pss AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pgs_id,
        pss_id
    FROM ancestry_matched_ess
),

ancestry_matched_pss_stats AS (
    SELECT
        pgs_id,
        pss_id,

        SUM(
            COALESCE(
                individuals_evaluation,
                COALESCE(cases_evaluation, 0)
                + COALESCE(controls_evaluation, 0)
            )
        ) AS individuals_evaluation,

        SUM(cases_evaluation) AS cases_evaluation,
        SUM(controls_evaluation) AS controls_evaluation

    FROM ancestry_matched_ess

    GROUP BY
        pgs_id,
        pss_id
),

matched_pss_metadata AS (
    SELECT
        matched.pgs_id,
        matched.pss_id,

        STRING_AGG(
            DISTINCT NULLIF(BTRIM(ess.cohort), ''),
            ' / '
            ORDER BY NULLIF(BTRIM(ess.cohort), '')
        ) AS cohort

    FROM ancestry_matched_pss AS matched

    LEFT JOIN data_libraries.evaluation_sample_sets AS ess
        ON BTRIM(ess.pss_id) = BTRIM(matched.pss_id)

    GROUP BY
        matched.pgs_id,
        matched.pss_id
)

SELECT
    pjr.pgs_id,

    CASE
        WHEN pcd.reported_trait IN (
            'Coronary artery disease',
            'Coronary Artery Disease'
        )
            THEN 'Coronary heart disease'

        WHEN pcd.reported_trait = 'Type 1 diabetes (T1D)'
            THEN 'Type 1 diabetes'

        WHEN pcd.reported_trait = 'Asthma (diagnosed by doctor)'
            THEN 'Asthma'

        WHEN pcd.reported_trait IN (
            'Type 2 diabetes (T2D)',
            'Type 2 diabetes (based on SNPs involved in β-cell function)'
        )
            THEN 'Type 2 diabetes'

        WHEN pcd.reported_trait = 'Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD)'
            THEN 'Inflammatory bowel disease'

        WHEN pcd.reported_trait IN (
            'Type 2 diabetes (based on SNPs involved in insulin secretion)',
            'Type 2 diabetes (based on SNPs associated with insulin secretion)'
        )
            THEN 'Type 2 diabetes'

        ELSE pcd.reported_trait
    END AS reported_trait,

    pcd.reported_trait AS source_reported_trait,
    pcd.mapped_trait_efo_label,
    pcd.efo_id,
    pp.reported_trait AS specific_trait,

    pjr.percentile_most_similar_pop,
    pjr.z_most_similar_pop,
    pjr.z_norm1,
    pjr.z_norm2,
    pjr.percent_variants_matched,
    pjr.n_variants_matched,

    pp.ppm_id,
    pp.pss_id,
    pp.pgp_id,

    pss_stats.individuals_evaluation,
    pss_stats.cases_evaluation,
    pss_stats.controls_evaluation,
    pss_metadata.cohort,
    '{ethnicity_sql}' AS broad_ancestry_category,

    pp.pgs_performance_other_relevant_info,
    pp.publication_pmid,
    pp.publication_doi,

    pp.hazard_ratio,
    pp.odds_ratio,
    pp.beta,
    pp.auroc,
    pp.concordance_statistic,

    pub.first_author,
    pub.title,
    pub.journal_name,
    pub.publication_date,
    pub.release_date AS publication_release_date,
    pub.authors,
    pub.pubmed_id_pmid,
    pub.digital_object_identifier_doi,

    pcd.publication_pmid AS development_publication_pmid,
    pcd.publication_doi AS development_publication_doi,
    pcd.pgp_id AS development_pgp_id,
    pcd.number_of_variants,
    pcd.original_genome_build,
    pcd.type_of_variant_weight,
    pcd.pgs_development_method,
    pcd.release_date AS pgs_release_date

FROM snpster_users.prsc_job_results AS pjr

INNER JOIN data_libraries.pgscatalog_data AS pcd
    ON pcd.pgs_id = pjr.pgs_id

-- Step 1: retain only PSS IDs relevant to the user's primary ancestry.
INNER JOIN ancestry_matched_pss AS matched_pss
    ON matched_pss.pgs_id = pjr.pgs_id

-- Step 2: use those PSS IDs to retrieve the associated PPM records.
INNER JOIN data_libraries.pgs_performance AS pp
    ON pp.pgs_id = matched_pss.pgs_id
   AND pp.pss_id = matched_pss.pss_id

-- Descriptive sample-size metadata for the already-selected ancestry rows.
LEFT JOIN ancestry_matched_pss_stats AS pss_stats
    ON pss_stats.pgs_id = matched_pss.pgs_id
   AND pss_stats.pss_id = matched_pss.pss_id

LEFT JOIN matched_pss_metadata AS pss_metadata
    ON pss_metadata.pgs_id = matched_pss.pgs_id
   AND pss_metadata.pss_id = matched_pss.pss_id

LEFT JOIN data_libraries.pgs_publications AS pub
    ON pub.pgp_id = pp.pgp_id

WHERE pjr.prsc_id = {prsc_id}
  AND (
        pp.auroc IS NOT NULL
        OR pp.concordance_statistic IS NOT NULL
        OR pp.odds_ratio IS NOT NULL
        OR pp.hazard_ratio IS NOT NULL
      )

ORDER BY
    reported_trait,
    pjr.pgs_id,
    pss_stats.individuals_evaluation DESC,
    pp.ppm_id;
"""

data = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(query)
data = data.drop_duplicates()

MIN_PRIMARY_VARIANT_MATCH_PCT = 70.0
