```{python}
def make_header_evidence_orbs(
    all_models,
    odds_ppms,
    hazard_ppms,
    all_ppms,
):
    """Compact evidence orbs aligned with the values displayed in the card."""

    if all_models is None or all_models.empty:
        n_scores = 0
    else:
        score_rows = all_models[
            pd.to_numeric(
                all_models["percentile_most_similar_pop"],
                errors="coerce",
            ).notna()
        ]

        if "pgs_id" in score_rows.columns:
            n_scores = int(
                score_rows["pgs_id"]
                .dropna()
                .astype(str)
                .nunique()
            )
        else:
            n_scores = int(len(score_rows))

    def metric_estimate_count(df, metric_col):
        if (
            df is None
            or df.empty
            or metric_col not in df.columns
        ):
            return 0

        valid = df[
            pd.to_numeric(
                df[metric_col],
                errors="coerce",
            ).notna()
        ]

        if "ppm_id" in valid.columns:
            return int(
                valid["ppm_id"]
                .dropna()
                .astype(str)
                .nunique()
            )

        return int(len(valid))

    n_odds = metric_estimate_count(
        odds_ppms,
        "individual_odds_ratio",
    )
    n_hazard = metric_estimate_count(
        hazard_ppms,
        "individual_hazard_ratio",
    )

    # OR and HR are separate plotted effects. A single performance record
    # that reports both contributes one estimate to each plot.
    n_effects = n_odds + n_hazard

    # Cohorts and publications describe the full performance-evaluation
    # table, not only evaluations that report a plottable OR or HR.
    evaluation_ppms = (
        all_ppms.copy()
        if all_ppms is not None
        else pd.DataFrame()
    )

    if (
        not evaluation_ppms.empty
        and "ppm_id" in evaluation_ppms.columns
    ):
        evaluation_ppms = evaluation_ppms.drop_duplicates(
            subset=["ppm_id"],
            keep="first",
        )

    if evaluation_ppms.empty:
        n_cohorts = 0
        n_publications = 0
    else:
        n_cohorts = count_unique_cohorts(
            evaluation_ppms
        )
        n_publications = count_unique_publications(
            evaluation_ppms
        )

    effect_tooltip = (
        f"{n_effects} displayed effect estimates: "
        f"{n_odds} odds and {n_hazard} hazard"
    )

    orb_specs = [
        (
            "scores",
            n_scores,
            "Scores",
            f"{n_scores} retained PGS scores shown in the percentile bar",
        ),
        ("effects", n_effects, "Effects", effect_tooltip),
        (
            "cohorts",
            n_cohorts,
            "Cohorts",
            f"{n_cohorts} unique cohorts in the evaluation table",
        ),
        (
            "publications",
            n_publications,
            "Publications",
            f"{n_publications} publications in the evaluation table",
        ),
    ]

    items = []
    for icon_name, value, label, tooltip in orb_specs:
        icon_svg = header_evidence_icon(icon_name)
        items.append(
            f"""
            <div class="header-evidence-item"
                 title="{html.escape(str(tooltip))}"
                 aria-label="{html.escape(str(tooltip))}">
              <div class="header-evidence-orb">
                <div class="header-evidence-icon">{icon_svg}</div>
                <div class="header-evidence-value">{value}</div>
              </div>
              <div class="header-evidence-label">{html.escape(label)}</div>
            </div>
            """
        )

    return f"""
    <div class="header-evidence-orbs"
         aria-label="Displayed score and validation evidence summary">
      {''.join(items)}
    </div>
    """



def record_display_context(record):
    """Return percentile, risk, agreement, and report-order context for one card."""
    primary = record["primary"]
    all_models = record["all_models"]

    percentile = primary["percentile_most_similar_pop"]
    distribution_stats = percentile_distribution_stats(all_models)
    show_distribution_view = use_distribution_percentile_view(all_models)

    display_percentile = (
        distribution_stats["median"]
        if show_distribution_view and distribution_stats is not None
        else percentile
    )

    risk_label, risk_class, fill_class = risk_level(display_percentile)
    agreement = model_agreement_stats(all_models)
    agreement_status = (
        agreement["status"]
        if agreement is not None
        else "Not assessable"
    )

    n_models = int(len(all_models))
    is_single = n_models <= 1

    moderate_or_better = agreement_status in {
        "Very high",
        "High",
        "Moderate",
    }

    if is_single:
        section = "single"
    elif moderate_or_better:
        section = "multi_supported"
    else:
        section = "low_agreement"

    return {
        "display_percentile": float(display_percentile),
        "distribution_stats": distribution_stats,
        "show_distribution_view": show_distribution_view,
        "risk_label": risk_label,
        "risk_class": risk_class,
        "fill_class": fill_class,
        "agreement": agreement,
        "agreement_status": agreement_status,
        "section": section,
    }


def trait_story_sentence(risk_label, agreement_status):
    """Return one concise, non-diagnostic interpretation sentence."""
    strong_agreement = agreement_status in {
        "Very high",
        "High",
        "Moderate",
    }

    if agreement_status == "Not assessable":
        if risk_label in {"Increased", "Highly Increased"}:
            return (
                "This PGS places you toward the higher end of the population distribution, "
                "but cross-model agreement cannot be assessed from a single retained score."
            )
        if risk_label in {"Lowered", "Very low"}:
            return (
                "This PGS places you toward the lower end of the population distribution, "
                "but cross-model agreement cannot be assessed from a single retained score."
            )
        return (
            "This PGS places you within the typical population range, but cross-model "
            "agreement cannot be assessed from a single retained score."
        )

    if risk_label in {"Increased", "Highly Increased"}:
        if strong_agreement:
            return (
                "The available PGS models consistently place you toward the higher end "
                "of the population distribution."
            )
        return (
            "Some PGS models suggest elevated genetic predisposition, but the models "
            "disagree about its magnitude."
        )

    if risk_label == "Normal":
        if strong_agreement:
            return (
                "The available PGS models consistently place you within the typical "
                "population range."
            )
        return (
            "The overall result falls within the typical population range, although "
            "individual PGS models vary considerably."
        )

    if strong_agreement:
        return (
            "The available PGS models consistently place you toward the lower end "
            "of the population distribution."
        )

    return (
        "Several PGS models suggest a lower percentile, but the models disagree "
        "about the magnitude."
    )



def make_trait_context_box(
    trait,
    interpretation,
    all_models,
    odds_models,
    hazard_models,
):
    """Build temporary trait-and-statistics copy for the card summary."""
    n_scores = (
        int(
            all_models["pgs_id"]
            .dropna()
            .astype(str)
            .nunique()
        )
        if (
            all_models is not None
            and not all_models.empty
            and "pgs_id" in all_models.columns
        )
        else 0
    )

    n_odds = int(len(odds_models)) if odds_models is not None else 0
    n_hazards = int(len(hazard_models)) if hazard_models is not None else 0
    n_effects = n_odds + n_hazards

    score_word = plural_word(n_scores, "score")
    effect_phrase = (
        f"{n_effects} published effect "
        f"{plural_word(n_effects, 'estimate')}"
        if n_effects
        else "the available published validation evidence"
    )

    description = (
        f"{trait} is the condition or phenotype represented by this card. "
        f"The card combines {n_scores} retained polygenic {score_word}, "
        "their percentile distribution and model agreement, "
        f"together with {effect_phrase}, validation performance, "
        "and variant coverage. These measures describe different parts "
        "of the evidence and should be interpreted together rather than "
        "as a diagnosis or an absolute-risk estimate."
    )

    return f"""
    <div class="pgs-context-box">
      <div class="pgs-context-heading">About this result</div>
      <div class="pgs-context-result">
        {html.escape(str(interpretation))}
      </div>
      <div class="pgs-context-description">
        {description}
      </div>
    </div>
    """




def make_summary_transition_marker():
    """Visual guide from the card summary into the detailed section."""
    return """
    <div class="pgs-summary-transition"
         aria-hidden="true">
      <div class="pgs-summary-transition-node">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"
             focusable="false"
             aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5"></path>
        </svg>
      </div>
    </div>
    """



def make_agreement_callout(card_section):
    """Show the caution tag on every card in the low-agreement section."""
    if card_section != "low_agreement":
        return ""

    return """
    <div class="agreement-callout">
      Models disagree substantially — interpret this result cautiously.
    </div>
    """


def plural_word(n, singular, plural=None):
    return singular if n == 1 else (plural or singular + "s")


def make_trait_card(record):
    primary = record["primary"]
    odds_models = record["odds_models"]
    hazard_models = record["hazard_models"]
    all_models = record["all_models"]
    all_ppms = record["all_ppms"]

    percentile = primary["percentile_most_similar_pop"]
    context = record_display_context(record)
    distribution_stats = context["distribution_stats"]
    show_distribution_view = context["show_distribution_view"]
    display_percentile = context["display_percentile"]
    risk_label = context["risk_label"]
    risk_class = context["risk_class"]
    fill_class = context["fill_class"]
    agreement_status = context["agreement_status"]
    card_section = context["section"]

    percentile_bar = make_percentile_bar(percentile, all_models, fill_class)
    consensus_box = make_consensus_box(all_models, percentile)
    interpretation = trait_story_sentence(risk_label, agreement_status)
    agreement_callout = make_agreement_callout(card_section)

    trait = safe_text(primary["reported_trait"])
    context_box = make_trait_context_box(
        trait,
        interpretation,
        all_models,
        odds_models,
        hazard_models,
    )
    summary_transition = make_summary_transition_marker()

    odds_bar = make_effect_bar_panel(
        "Odds-based risk",
        odds_models,
        "individual_odds_ratio",
        "odds_ratio",
        "OR",
    )

    hazard_bar = make_effect_bar_panel(
        "Hazard-based risk",
        hazard_models,
        "individual_hazard_ratio",
        "hazard_ratio",
        "HR",
    )

    effect_bar_items = "".join([odds_bar, hazard_bar])

    effect_bars = (
        f"""
        <div class="effect-bar-stack">
          {effect_bar_items}
        </div>
        """
        if effect_bar_items.strip()
        else ""
    )

    (
        performance_label,
        performance_numeric,
        n_validation_pgss,
        n_validation_ppms,
    ) = card_discrimination_summary(all_models)

    performance_value = fmt_float(performance_numeric, 2)

    if performance_label is not None:
        if len(all_models) > 1:
            performance_caption = (
                f"Equal-score mean across {n_validation_pgss} retained polygenic scores · "
                f"{n_validation_ppms} validation estimates"
            )
        else:
            performance_caption = (
                f"Mean across {n_validation_ppms} ancestry-matched validation "
                f"{plural_word(n_validation_ppms, 'value')}"
            )
    else:
        performance_caption = None

    if show_distribution_view:
        variant_match_value = fmt_variant_match_pct(mean_variant_match_pct(all_models))
        variant_match_caption = f"Mean across {len(all_models)} retained models"
    else:
        variant_match_value = fmt_variant_match_pct(primary.get("percent_variants_matched", np.nan))
        variant_match_caption = (
            f"{fmt_int(primary.get('n_variants_matched', np.nan))} variants matched in primary model"
            if fmt_int(primary.get("n_variants_matched", np.nan))
            else "Primary model"
        )

    performance_rating = metric_rating(
        "discrimination",
        performance_numeric,
    )
    variant_rating = metric_rating(
        "variant_match",
        mean_variant_match_pct(all_models) if show_distribution_view else primary.get("percent_variants_matched", np.nan),
    )

    metric_boxes = ""
    metric_boxes += make_metric_box(
        performance_label,
        performance_value,
        performance_caption,
        status=performance_rating,
    )
    metric_boxes += make_metric_box("Variant match", variant_match_value, variant_match_caption, status=variant_rating)

    model_agreement = make_model_agreement(all_models)
    header_evidence_orbs = make_header_evidence_orbs(
        all_models,
        odds_models,
        hazard_models,
        all_ppms,
    )

    models_dropdown = make_models_dropdown(all_models, all_ppms)

    return f"""
    <article class="pgs-card card-risk-{risk_class}">
      <div class="pgs-card-header">
        <div class="pgs-header-left">
          <div class="pgs-title-row">
            <h3 class="pgs-title">{trait}</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="pgs-header-right">
          {header_evidence_orbs}
        </div>

        <div class="pgs-percentile-hero"
             aria-label="Percentile {fmt_percentile(display_percentile)}">
          <div class="pgs-percentile-hero-label">
            {"Median percentile" if show_distribution_view else "Percentile"}
          </div>
          <div class="pgs-percentile-hero-value">
            {fmt_percentile(display_percentile)}
          </div>
          <div class="pgs-percentile-hero-badge">
            <div class="risk-badge risk-{risk_class}">{risk_label}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="pgs-percentile-hero-caption">
            Relative to the reference population
          </div>
          <div class="pgs-percentile-hero-rule"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {context_box}
      {agreement_callout}
      {summary_transition}

      <section class="pgs-detailed-section">
        <div class="card-details-divider">
          <div class="card-details-divider-title">Detailed results</div>
          {model_agreement}
        </div>

        <div class="percentile-block">
          <div class="percentile-topline">
            <div class="percentile-label">{"Median percentile" if show_distribution_view else "Percentile"}</div>
            <div class="percentile-value">{fmt_percentile(display_percentile)}</div>
          </div>
          {percentile_bar}
          {consensus_box}
        </div>

        {effect_bars}

        <div class="metric-grid">
          {metric_boxes}
        </div>

        <div class="metadata-panel">
          {models_dropdown}
        </div>
      </section>
    </article>
    """

def sort_records_by_percentile(records):
    """Order cards from highest displayed percentile to lowest."""
    return sorted(
        records,
        key=lambda record: (
            -record_display_context(record)["display_percentile"],
            str(record["reported_trait"]).lower(),
        ),
    )


def section_emblem_svg(section_class):
    """Return a clean line icon for each result section."""
    icons = {
        "standout": """
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
  <path d="M4 16h16"></path>
  <path d="M7 12h10"></path>
  <path d="M10 8h4"></path>
  <path d="M12 5v14"></path>
</svg>
""",
        "other": """
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
  <rect x="6.5" y="4.5" width="11" height="15" rx="2.2"></rect>
  <path d="M9 9h6"></path>
  <path d="M9 13h6"></path>
</svg>
""",
        "caution": """
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
  <path d="M12 4.5l8 14H4z"></path>
  <path d="M12 9v4.8"></path>
  <path d="M12 17.2h.01"></path>
</svg>
""",
    }

    return icons.get(section_class, icons["other"])


def render_story_section(title, subtitle, records, section_class):
    if not records:
        return ""

    cards = "\n".join(
        f'<div class="card-stack-item">{make_trait_card(record)}</div>'
        for record in sort_records_by_percentile(records)
    )

    section_kickers = {
        "standout": "Moderate-or-better agreement",
        "other": "One retained score",
        "caution": "Interpret with more caution",
    }
    kicker = section_kickers.get(section_class, "Results")
    section_icon = section_emblem_svg(section_class)
    section_ids = {
        "standout": "multi-pgs-results",
        "other": "single-pgs-results",
        "caution": "low-model-agreement",
    }
    section_id = section_ids.get(section_class, "polygenic-results")

    return f"""
    <section
      class="story-section story-section-{section_class}"
      id="{section_id}"
    >
      <div class="story-section-header">
        <div class="story-section-header-main">
          <div class="story-section-emblem">
            {section_icon}
          </div>
          <div class="story-section-copy">
            <div class="story-section-kicker">{html.escape(kicker)}</div>
            <h2 class="story-section-title">{html.escape(title)}</h2>
            <div class="story-section-subtitle">{html.escape(subtitle)}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="story-section-count">
          {len(records)} {plural_word(len(records), "trait")}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div
        class="story-section-flow-divider"
        aria-hidden="true"
      ></div>
      <div class="pgs-card-grid">
        {cards}
      </div>
    </section>
    """


section_contexts = [
    (record, record_display_context(record))
    for record in card_records
]

multi_supported_records = [
    record
    for record, context in section_contexts
    if context["section"] == "multi_supported"
]

single_records = [
    record
    for record, context in section_contexts
    if context["section"] == "single"
]

low_agreement_records = [
    record
    for record, context in section_contexts
    if context["section"] == "low_agreement"
]

multi_supported_html = render_story_section(
    "Multi-PGS results",
    (
        "Traits with more than one retained PGS model and at least Moderate model "
        "agreement, ordered from highest displayed percentile to lowest."
    ),
    multi_supported_records,
    "standout",
)

single_html = render_story_section(
    "Single-PGS results",
    (
        "Traits represented by one retained PGS model. Cross-model agreement cannot "
        "be assessed; results are ordered from highest percentile to lowest."
    ),
    single_records,
    "other",
)

low_agreement_html = render_story_section(
    "Results with low model agreement",
    (
        "Multi-PGS traits with Low or Very low model agreement, separated at "
        "the end of the report and ordered from highest displayed percentile "
        "to lowest."
    ),
    low_agreement_records,
    "caution",
)

display(HTML(
    multi_supported_html
    + single_html
    + low_agreement_html
))
```


```{=html}
<details id="report-methodology" class="method-note method-details">
  <summary>How this report works</summary>
  <div class="method-details-content">
    <p><strong>Panel profile index.</strong> The whole-report index is the arithmetic mean of the displayed trait percentiles, with every trait receiving equal weight. It is shown as a compact 0–100 reference value and is a descriptive profile summary, not a combined clinical-risk score.</p>
    <p><strong>Ancestry-specific validation evidence.</strong> The user's primary ancestry is mapped to a curated set of compatible labels used in <code>evaluation_sample_sets.broad_ancestry_category</code>. Because an Evaluation Sample Set can list several ancestries in one comma-separated value, the report matches recognized ancestry tokens rather than requiring the entire field to equal one label. For example, a European user can retain both <code>European</code> and mixed entries such as <code>European, African unspecified</code>; African, East Asian, South Asian, and Admixed American users similarly use curated compatible labels. Ambiguous categories such as unspecified Asian ancestry, generic admixed ancestry, Greater Middle Eastern ancestry, Oceanian ancestry, and unreported ancestry are not forced into one of SNPster's five superpopulations. Sex/gender composition is not used in this ancestry filter. The ancestry-matched cohort identifiers then restrict the performance evaluations considered for each polygenic score.</p>
    <p><strong>Evidence labels.</strong> Model agreement and validation-performance badges use an ordered low-to-high scale rather than value-laden terms such as good or bad. These labels describe statistical consistency or discrimination, not whether the user's health result is favorable.</p>
    <p><strong>Card summary text.</strong> Each card currently includes a generic plain-language box that combines the personalized percentile interpretation with a temporary explanation of the trait and the statistics shown in the card. This text is designed to be replaced by curated, database-backed trait descriptions.</p>
    <p><strong>Card grouping and performance-evaluation representation.</strong> Polygenic scores are clustered into cards using an explicit curated trait-family override when one is configured, followed by two general links: an ontology-aware key derived from <code>pgscatalog_data.efo_id</code>, and an exact match of the trimmed <code>reported_trait</code> text. Curated overrides take precedence over ontology matching so a known broad or incorrect ontology assignment cannot pull an unrelated score into the card. Outside the curated overrides, a match by either general route joins the scores and the links are applied transitively. When one or more MONDO identifiers are present, the MONDO subset defines the ontology key and accompanying EFO, HP, or PATO terms are treated as contextual modifiers. Without MONDO, PATO modifiers are ignored when another ontology identifier remains. Multiple core identifiers are preserved as an unordered set for genuinely composite endpoints. When ontology IDs are unavailable, the mapped EFO label can still provide the ontology-side link. The visible card title remains a human-readable <code>pgscatalog_data.reported_trait</code> selected from the primary PGS in the resulting card cluster. Percentile, z-score, variant match, and model agreement are represented once per polygenic score because they are properties of the user's score result rather than of an individual performance row. By contrast, odds-ratio and hazard-ratio plots retain every ancestry-matched performance evaluation that reports the corresponding effect, so more-stratified outcomes from <code>pgs_performance.reported_trait</code> remain visible. The Scores orb counts distinct retained PGS IDs contributing a datapoint to the percentile bar. The Effects orb counts the OR and HR estimates actually plotted; a performance evaluation that reports both contributes one estimate to each plot. The Cohorts orb splits compound values such as <code>JHS|CHS|ARIC</code> and counts each distinct cohort across every row in the ancestry-matched performance-evaluation table. Publications similarly counts the distinct PMID-or-DOI identifiers shown in the Literature column across the full table, including evaluations without an OR or HR. The technical dropdown separately reports the total number of ancestry-matched performance evaluations, including records without OR or HR.</p>
    <p><strong>Validation discrimination.</strong> Within each polygenic score, every ancestry-matched performance evaluation contributes one discrimination value when available: AUROC is used when reported, otherwise the concordance statistic. These values are averaged to create one descriptive validation-discrimination value per polygenic score. For a multi-score card, the displayed overall validation statistic is then the mean of the score-level means, giving every polygenic score equal weight regardless of how many performance evaluations it has. This is a descriptive summary rather than a formal meta-analysis, particularly when AUROC and concordance statistics or endpoint definitions differ.</p>
    <p><strong>Model selection.</strong> PGS models with less than 70% matched variants or missing variant-match data are removed from the report entirely before model agreement, consensus estimates, overview figures, or card construction are calculated. The card's primary PGS is ranked by its mean ancestry-matched validation discrimination, then by the largest available evaluation sample size.</p>
    <p><strong>Model families and SNPster weighted effects.</strong> Within each development publication and reported trait, scores with the same non-missing development method receive the same descriptive family ID. For odds- and hazard-based plots only, the SNPster weighted mean uses raw weight <code>(1 / family size) × performance-record AUROC or concordance × variant-match fraction</code>. Percentile summaries remain unweighted.</p>
    <p><strong>Model agreement.</strong> For cards with more than four retained percentile values, agreement is classified from IQR width. For cards with two to four values, agreement uses the full minimum-to-maximum distance. Spread below 5 percentile points is Very high agreement, below 10 is High, below 20 is Moderate, 20–25 is Low, and above 25 is Very low. A single retained PGS is Not assessable.</p>
    <p><strong>Distribution display.</strong> Multi-PGS percentile cards show the IQR as the translucent band and Tukey whiskers as the skinny colored line. More extreme PGS values remain visible as gray points. Odds and hazard bars are centered on 0% change and show between-model spread rather than statistical confidence intervals.</p>
  </div>
</details>
```


## Methodological notes

```{=html}
<div class="method-note">
  <strong>Important limitations.</strong>
  Polygenic scores estimate inherited genetic predisposition; they are not diagnostic tests.
  AUROC/concordance summaries, odds ratios, and hazard ratios come from ancestry-matched cohort-level performance records and may still not transfer perfectly across age groups, sex, genotyping arrays, imputation pipelines, or more fine-grained ancestry differences.
  The individualized risk-effect calculation assumes that the source odds ratio or hazard ratio is reported per standard deviation of the PRS. If the original publication used a different effect unit or comparison group, the transformed percentage may be misleading and should be flagged in your score-selection database.
</div>
```
